verdict.rationale: Whether a work-management SaaS publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack says monday.com's own product source is available under an open license. The only open-source mentions are Vibe, a React component library for building apps that look native. That is an adjacent developer building block, not the product's source, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
